opening.argument: The promotion offers a defined $50 iTunes gift card once the channel reaches 10,000 subscribers: “I will be doing a $50 dollar ITunes giveaway when we reach 10,000 subscribers.” Viewers are asked to support that growth by sharing the channel and engaging with the video, as the speaker says, “so make sure to share the channel with your friends and like and subscribe to this video.” These are ordinary audience-engagement actions tied to a stated giveaway condition. Nothing presented requires payment, requests credentials, directs viewers to an external destination, or describes another deceptive financial participation mechanism. The offer therefore reflects a conventional loyalty or promotional reward based on channel participation, with no stated loss, payment, or financial outcome beyond the proposed gift card.
